errors.retry_where_meaningful: Retry availability (G catalogue/availability), Retry intelligence (E), Retry telemetry (F), Retry events (D)
errors.visual: role=alert, danger-tinted panel; reserved for transport failures and invalid requests — never for valid unsupported states

loading.language: Checking/Loading/Running + ellipsis; single quiet status lines, no spinner wall
loading.no_layout_jumps: min-h placeholders on timeline status; disclosures reserve no space until opened (native); result regions appear only on explicit intent

refusals.counterfactual_unsupported: Alternative unavailable at this state + frozen reason code (e.g. unobserved_roster_member, INVALID_TRIGGER)
refusals.event_partial: Event data unavailable for this race + Retry events (distinct from empty)
refusals.intelligence_unavailable: Model x simulation unavailable at this state + typed reason + Missing is not zero
refusals.strategy_unsupported: Strategy unavailable at this state + frozen reason (unprecomputed vs typed engine reason)
refusals.telemetry_unavailable: Telemetry unavailable for this race + Retry telemetry (distinct from no-laps)
refusals.treatment: uniform compact statusClass typography; distinct wording preserved per semantics; no alarming error styling for valid unsupported states (neutral text, no danger classes in pit-wall)
